name: Motif
description: Interface parts for AI agents and generative media. Ready to use, themeable shadcn components for React.
descriptionLong: Motif is a shadcn-compatible registry of interface parts for AI agents and generative media — conversation, reasoning, approvals, and the controls that frame them. Install via the CLI, own the source, and restyle it with your theme tokens.
features: shadcn CLI install — components live in your repo
Compound parts you can rearrange per surface
Every colour is a theme token, so dark mode is free
